newsitem.title: UK: Gehe says has 20.91 pct of Lloyds Chemists.
newsitem.headline: Gehe says has 20.91 pct of Lloyds Chemists.

text.p: German drug wholesaler Gehe AG said on Friday its unit Gehe Invest had acquired 20.91 percent of the ordinary share capital of British pharmaceutical chain Lloyds Chemists by 1630 GMT.
Gehe said Gehe Invest also had acquired 5.82 percent of the issued preference share capital of Lloyds Chemists.
Gehe earlier on Friday lifted its cash bid for Lloyds to 525p per share from 500p, valuing Lloyds at 684.1 million pounds and trumping a rival bid from British drugs group Unichem.

Gehe said that, as of 1500 GMT, it had valid acceptances of its ordinary share offer representing around 0.18 percent of Lloyds Chemists and acceptances for around 1.45 percent of the company's preference share capital.
Gehe said its offer will close at 1300 GMT on January 31.
